g.text: Measured service time against the bounds meant to hold it
a request can succeed only when
, and a retry budget is honest only when
beyond the old bound, within the new
Both conditions failed at once, which is why a healthy node read as a broken one. Every measurement exceeds the 20 s request bound, so no attempt
could finish; and a 45 s budget cannot hold two 20 s attempts plus retry overhead, so it ended the operation part-way through a second attempt that was
equally doomed. The caller received one 500, with no way to distinguish "the node is unreachable" from "the node needed 24 s and was allowed 20".
s, and the test asserts the relationship
rather than either constant — it was the relationship that broke.
